subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw publish `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in hosted no-key web search provider while Firecrawl's public API reference still marks bearer auth as required generally?
rationale: The code follows the existing keyless-provider pattern and live no-auth search now works, but this creates a new public provider id and query-routing privacy/support boundary that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the opt-in provider
options.body: Merge after maintainer approval that observed no-auth Firecrawl search is stable enough and acceptable for user search-query routing.

options.title: Keep Firecrawl search credentialed
options.body: Ask the contributor to remove `firecrawl-free` and keep only the keyed `firecrawl_search` option expansion.

options.title: Wait for upstream confirmation
options.body: Hold the PR until Firecrawl documents or confirms no-auth `/v2/search` as a supported hosted starter contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in provider
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer approval that observed no-auth Firecrawl search is stable enough and acceptable for user search-query routing.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest history-backed owner for the provider boundary is the recent keyless Firecrawl scrape/fetch author and current Firecrawl area contributor.
